segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip pushed open the heavy wooden door, and you slipped inside the Old Clockwork Mill.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The interior was massive, silent, and smelling of ancient cedar, machine oil, and cold river stone. Overhead, giant wooden gears the size of Ferris wheels hung suspended from the rafters, frozen in time and draped in thick silver spiderwebs. In the center of the room, a massive iron drive-shaft dropped straight through the floor into the icy depths of the frozen river below.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: Follow me, recruit,

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip whispered, gesturing toward a creaky spiral staircase of notched timber.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: Mind the seventh step. It squeaks in B-flat.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You follow Pip up to the loft, and your jaw drops.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: This was clearly where Pip lived—and worked:

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Hanging across the back wall was a massive green chalkboard covered in frantic chalk scribbles, question marks, and messy loops of red yarn connecting bizarre newspaper clippings (

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: IS SANTA AN ILLUSION?

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: WHERE DO THE MISSING HOURS GO?

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: WHO STOLE MY SHORTBREAD?

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: A small cast-iron stove in the corner was glowing with warm amber coals, heating a dented copper kettle that whistled softly.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: A desk was buried under magnifying glasses, brass calipers, hollowed-out pocket watches, and half-eaten gingerbread men.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip paced back and forth on his hind legs, his tail twitching in frustration.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: I don't understand it!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip cried, throwing his furry paws in the air.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: The whisper said: 'When the thirteenth bell sighs, the cog turns where the cold river lies.' I have lived in this mill for two years! I have inspected every plank, every cobweb, every crumpet crumb! There is no secret cog in this room!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You look around the dusty room. Your mind feels that familiar, quiet buzz—the part of your brain that always notices what other people walk right past.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: There is definitely something hidden here. You just need to know where to look.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: What do you want to inspect first?
